name: smoke-image
title: Smoke: an empty image and a PNG
description: The smallest graph that proves a ComfyUI server works end to end: Empty Image -> Save Image. No checkpoint, no LoRA, no input file, no custom node - so if this one runs, the server, the queue, the output folder and this package's compiler are all working, and a failure is never about a missing 2 GB download. Run it with `comfy_test` action=run first on any new machine.
